content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur and the RUNNER Trial
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is a medical institute in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. This vacancy is in the Department of Pulmonary Medicine. It is for an ICMR-funded extramural research project called "A Randomized Trial of Enhanced Immunosuppression versus antifibrotic therapy and drug response prediction in progressive pulmonary fibrosis (RUNNER trial)". The Principal Investigator is Dr. Naveen Dutt, Professor & Head, Department of Pulmonary Medicine.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice says the salary is a consolidated sum with no other benefits. It depends on the candidate's experience, qualifications and skill set. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Three years of graduation (Science/Psychology/Public Health) + three years' experience in a relevant subject/field. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be full-time and from a recognised Board or University. The experience must have been gained after getting the minimum educational qualification for the post. Experienced and skilled persons may get an age concession equal to the service they have given in other research projects. This is decided case by case and applies only to ICMR projects. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview at AIIMS Jodhpur. If there are many applicants, the Competent Authority may also hold a screening or security test.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Venue
content_sections.text: Room No. 031, Ground Floor, B Block, OPD, Department of Pulmonary Medicine, AIIMS, Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first contract is for one year from the date of appointment. It may be extended for one more year based on the performance evaluation report (as per norms) and the project's needs. The position can be ended at any time. The appointment is purely temporary and contractual and ends with the project. The candidate has no right to claim permanent employment at AIIMS Jodhpur or to continue in any other project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technical Support-III Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Filled application form with a passport-size photo Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents for age, educational qualifications and work experience No Objection Certificate, if you work in a Government department or a Public Sector Undertaking No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify you. No enquiries will be answered after the due date.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the AIIMS Jodhpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 3 November 2026 in Room No. 031, Ground Floor, B Block, OPD, Department of Pulmonary Medicine, AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I report?
faq.answer: Reporting starts at 09:00 AM. No candidates are allowed in after 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: You need three years of graduation in Science, Psychology or Public Health, plus three years' experience in a relevant subject or field. The experience must have been gained after you qualified.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age concession?
faq.answer: Yes. Experienced and skilled persons may get an age concession equal to their service in other research projects, decided case by case. This applies only to ICMR projects.

faq.question: Q5. Which project will I work on?
faq.answer: You will work on the ICMR-funded RUNNER trial on progressive pulmonary fibrosis. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Naveen Dutt, Professor & Head, Department of Pulmonary Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: It is for one year at first. It may be extended for one more year depending on performance and the project's needs, and it can be ended at any time.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if there are many applicants. In that case, the Competent Authority may hold a screening or security test.

faq.question: Q8. Do government employees need any extra document?
faq.answer: Yes. People working in a Government department or a Public Sector Undertaking must bring a No Objection Certificate to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will AIIMS Jodhpur pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
